draft.title: Reporting an investigation
card: A report presents what was found so that another person can follow it and check it. Use correct physics terms and give every measurement with its unit, such as 2.4 m/s or 15 N.

Give results to a sensible number of significant figures. A value should not show more digits than the measuring instrument can support. A ruler marked in millimetres cannot give a length such as 12.3456 cm.

Draw a graph to show a pattern. Put the independent variable on the horizontal axis and the dependent variable on the vertical axis. Label each axis with its quantity and unit, and draw a line of best fit through the points.
Link the findings to physics ideas. State what the results show, then explain it using a relevant concept, model or law.
draft.remember: A good report gives units, sensible significant figures and labelled graphs, then links results to physics.

a.q: A student times a trolley with a stopwatch that reads to 0.01 s. Which way of reporting the time best follows good reporting practice?
opts: 2.4 s, rounded to match a 1 s clock
a.why: 2.35 s has a unit and a number of digits that matches the stopwatch. 2.3517 s shows more digits than the instrument can support. 2.35 has no unit, so it is incomplete.
a.clue: Check the unit and the digits the instrument can give.

b.q: Priya measures how the stretch of a spring changes as she adds mass. She chooses the mass to add and measures the stretch. Which graph setup is correct?
opts: Mass on the horizontal axis, stretch on the vertical axis
Stretch on the horizontal axis, mass on the vertical axis
Mass and stretch both with no axis labels
Mass on the horizontal axis, with a line joining every point
b.why: Mass is the independent variable, so it goes on the horizontal axis, and stretch is the dependent variable on the vertical axis. Swapping them is tempting, but the variable Priya controls goes on the horizontal axis. Axes also need labels with units, and a line of best fit is drawn, not a line joining every point.
b.clue: Which quantity did Priya choose, and which did she measure?

b.best: Mass on the horizontal axis, stretch on the vertical axis

problems.detail: The distractor '2.4 s, rounded to match a 1 s clock' contradicts itself. A 1 s clock would give 2 s, not 2.4 s, which has 0.1 s resolution. This could confuse students, and the why does not explain this option.
